title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group from diverse backgrounds with an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s products & services can play a critical role in doing so. We strive to act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR).

  • You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • You will be proficient with macOS in an enterprise environment, troubleshoot with the terminal, and procure and deliver technology equipment.
  • You will own the onboarding experience for new employees and the tech retrieval process for outgoing employees.
  • You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, contributing improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf).
  • You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta), document solutions, and automate repetitive tasks.
  • You will manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents as needed, and work on projects over sprints with Jira and agile methods.
  • You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain concepts clearly and compassionately.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack communications.
  • Understanding of security concepts, PGP, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Self-management and the ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line tools experience.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Ability to thrive in a startup/tech environment, with adaptability and resilience.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and collaborating across functions with empathy and clarity.

The Benefits

  • Competitive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Comprehensive PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Shared equity; employees are stakeholders in Ledn’s future.
  • Remote-work option: work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A meaningful career with purpose, and a culture that removes barriers to doing great work.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer; we value inclusivity and diversity.
  • Accommodation requests: contact Ledn team at the provided email for confidential handling throughout the recruitment process.

Ledn Working Environment: We are a global, remote-first team with staff across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

title: Proposal Manager
description:
Overview

The Proposal Manager is responsible for providing overall management throughout the entire proposal lifecycle in response to Request for Proposals (RFPs). The successful candidate should be an expert at leading proposal teams, coordinating and managing proposal related meetings and responses, and in creating all necessary proposal related documents.

The successful candidate will have experience performing in fast-paced, dynamic office environments while ensuring schedule milestones and delivery dates are met. The candidate shall be highly organized with a strict attention to detail and experienced in multi-tasking and handling high priority projects.

Responsibilities

  • Provides direct management of the proposal team from bid approval through award
  • Develops all necessary proposal documentation (e.g., compliance matrixes, proposal outlines, writing assignments, responsibility matrices, proposal-related questions, annotated outlines, finalized proposal documents, oral presentations, lessons learned, etc.) to win the assigned bid
  • Facilitates proposal strategy sessions with capture and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs); capturing marketing-oriented hot buttons, win themes, and features and benefits
  • Ensures the response clearly conveys the proper key messages, value propositions, and differentiators
  • Works closely with business development teams and Senior Leadership to incorporate executive feedback, input, and vision
  • Manages virtual and physical proposal teams of complex skills and functions to include Proposal Coordinators, Writers, Editors, Graphic Artists, Executive Personnel, and SMEs
  • Facilitates color reviews, including debrief meetings and recovery strategy
  • Ensures proposal documentation receives appropriate internal/capture management approval; coordinating any necessary updates and certifying compliance
  • Coordinates and leads all proposal team meetings, such as kick-off meetings, periodic proposal team standup meetings, color reviews, and other meetings as needed
  • Manages proposal-specific content in Salesforce, SpringCM, SharePoint, and MS Teams content management repositories and proposal-specific workspaces
  • Collaborates with other professionals (Business Developers, Capture Managers, SMEs, and senior-level management) to clearly articulate a winning strategy, compelling solutions, and substantiated themes
  • When necessary, serves as liaison between subcontractors and/or prime contractors on behalf of Kearney
  • Researches, analyzes, creates, documents, and shares proposal boilerplate, including proof points; past proposals for lessons learned, reuse; and past performance data
  • In coordination with the Proposal Coordinator, creates and maintains high-quality templates and process documentation
  • Edits and rewrites text as needed - leveraging existing boilerplate text, where appropriate
  • Oversees the development and maintenance of proposal-specific graphics
  • Assists the Proposal Coordinator in the overall production, packaging, and delivery of proposals, when required
  • Serves as the quality assurance function for final products, ensuring quality and compliance
  • Assists in identifying lessons learned and/or gaps in provided resources in order to improve the proposal process
  • Has the ability to obtain and maintain a Government security clearance

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience managing proposal development/processes, preferably for proposals developed in response to U.S. Federal Government solicitations
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Extreme attention to detail
  • Working knowledge of MS Office Suite applications (MS Word (advanced), Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  • Experience working with SharePoint and Salesforce platforms preferred
  • Must be detail oriented and able to work with minimal supervision
  • Must be willing to work the hours necessary to accomplish the tasks assigned which may include evenings, weekend, or overtime hours, as needed.

Other Requirements :

  • Must be flexible in adapting to deadlines, changing schedules, priorities and unpredictable events
  • Must be a team player with a “whatever it takes” attitude
  • Ability to proactively identify issues and develop timely resolutions
  • Ability to work in a high-stress deadline driven environment
  • Ability to mentor other team members.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building Ledn to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about innovation and creative problem solving, and adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role requires a highly motivated, dependable technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Support macOS in an enterprise setting; procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM with Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints with Jira (agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to use open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP; knowledge of networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a PTO package and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, global team and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may request a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. No agencies or recruiters, please.

title: Data Product Manager
description:
Data Product Manager

Location: REMOTE

Annual Compensation: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 (DOE)

The Data Product Manager leads the definition, development, and lifecycle management of high-quality, reusable data products that drive value across business domains and the enterprise. Serving as a strategic link between business and technical teams, this role ensures data products are discoverable, well-governed, and interoperable from ideation through retirement.

You will oversee the creation and stewardship of enterprise reference data, including hospitals, helipads, airports, air ambulance bases, customers, health insurance plans, and payors. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in research, data management, and governance, along with exceptional organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Coordination (20%)

  • Lead the development and management of GMR’s reference data processes, including stewardship, versioning, and golden record creation, in alignment with data lake and analytics strategies.
  • Define data quality metrics, standards, and SLAs.
  • Address data duplication, inconsistency, and fragmentation; develop and enforce data governance policies and operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT and security to standardize data access controls and support metadata management tool implementation (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
  • Assess data maturity, identify gaps, and implement improvements to ensure trusted, accessible, and well-managed data products.

Reference Data Research & Maintenance (60%)

  • Build and maintain comprehensive reference data for hospitals, customer profiles, transportation providers, airports, and fuel depots to support downstream workflows such as customer experience personalization and automation of eligibility and authorization processes.
  • Conduct ongoing research to maintain a current database of all U.S. air ambulance bases, including key operational details.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures for data research, maintenance, and change management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Leverage enterprise data hubs and services for data storage, cataloging, maintenance, and sharing across key applications.

Data Integration & Synchronization (10%)

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Ambulance Communications, Clinical Informatics, Revenue Cycle, and IT Data Teams—to synchronize reference data across critical systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting (10%)

  • Develop reports and visualizations for reference data, market analysis, and air/ground decision-making.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Education & Industry Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years in data management roles, including database administration, data governance, master data management, or enterprise data strategy
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational databases, and data warehouse technologies, with a strong ability to analyze and validate data quality and lineage
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Domo)
  • Skilled in research, data collection, maintenance, and spatial analysis (GIS strongly preferred)
  • Background in healthcare, air and ground medical transport, or dispatch environments
  • Proven experience developing data products, managing master data, and working with metadata tools and data cataloging platforms
  • Proficient in maintaining reference databases and spreadsheets
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and governance tools (e.g., Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra) is a plus

Why Choose GMR?

Global Medical Response (GMR) and its family of solutions are dedicated to delivering compassionate, quality medical care, primarily in the areas of emergency and patient relocation services. Here you’ll embark on meaningful work that will make an impact on you and the customers we serve. This posting reflects the role and its requirements; no additional site-wide notices are included here.

EEO Statement

Global Medical Response and its family of companies are an Equal Opportunity Employer, which includes supporting veterans and providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with a disability.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location and benefits — Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona; flexible parental leave benefits; opportunities for cross-functional growth and collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Marketing and Sales
  • Industries: Advertising Services

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
Overview

INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role supports Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on NetSuite experience, and enjoys a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within NetSuite.

Location: Remote (EST work hours preferred). Remote work opportunity is offered as part of the role.

What we offer: professional development opportunities, a collaborative team environment, and participation in company initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • NetSuite Accounting Data Management: Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite; ensure completeness and accuracy of all entries across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll; conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues; support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.
  • Testing & System Validation: Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules; validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll; perform UAT during NetSuite updates or enhancements; work with Accounting, Finance, and IT to identify and troubleshoot system errors or configuration gaps; help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Month-End & Operational Support: Support the month-end close by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite; assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports; ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.
  • Documentation & Internal Support: Maintain accurate documentation of NetSuite processes, data input standards, and workflows; assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues; contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls; perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation; understanding of US GAAP; excellent attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team; capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment; proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation; effective communication and organizational skills.

What We Offer

  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participation in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • Opportunity for professional development and growth.
  • A rapidly growing company with a collaborative and supportive team environment.

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.

About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable.   • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.

What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.

  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.

Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.

At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; experience shipping and receiving hardware and handling customs.

Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.

Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.

Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.

title: Senior Financial/Accounting Specialist - Simpaul Brazil (EN Speaker)
description:
Overview

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 280 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Company Overview: Simpaul is 100% a Binance Company. The M&A was fully approved by the Brazilian Central Bank in December 2024. This strategic acquisition strengthens our presence in the Brazilian market and enhances our capabilities in the fintech sector.

Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist.

This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, in alignment with both local regulatory requirements and Binance’s global standards. You will be the main point of contact for accounting, tax, and regulatory matters, supporting the business in a fast-paced and high-growth environment.

Note: This role is 100% Remote, Work From Home based. Working Visa is not sponsored.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes in accordance with local Brazilian regulations — particularly Receita Federal and Banco Central do Brasil — while ensuring compliance with Binance’s global finance policies.
  • Collaborate closely with the internal finance team to manage accounting and financial processes, ensuring accurate and timely accounting and tax closing.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the external accounting firm, monitoring deliverables, service quality, and outcomes.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Finance/Accounting in implementing upcoming cryptoasset regulations in Brazil, advising on impacts, requirements, and execution plans.
  • Monitor, analyze, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all regulatory reports to authorities such as the Banco Central do Brasil and Receita Federal do Brasil (e.g., CADOCs, statutory financial and tax filings).
  • Develop and maintain the company’s accounting, operational, and capital policies in line with current regulations, business needs, and Binance’s strategic directives (e.g., capital adequacy policies vs. transaction accounting).
  • Track and interpret changes in laws, resolutions, and regulatory instructions related to brokerage and payment activities, ensuring ongoing compliance and regulatory security.
  • Oversee and support all tax-related initiatives, including compliance with tax obligations, implementation of tax reform changes, and corporate reorganization or optimization projects.
  • Lead external audit activities, ensuring alignment with both regulatory requirements and Binance’s internal policies and practices.
  • Drive and support system implementation projects and the launch of new products, focusing on financial and accounting requirements.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the company on business process development, monitoring, and continuous improvement (e.g., internal audit, internal controls, policy updates).
  • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge in accounting, finance, financial operations, cash management, tax, and payment processes.
  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.
  • Previous exposure to core banking systems (preferred).

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

About Ledn

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll balance help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and align them to the team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You know how to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs and integrate one system to another.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; able to explain ideas clearly and help users calmly.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others; you take security seriously and know what PGP is.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. Familiar with OSI model troubleshooting steps. Ability to self-manage and scope projects across multiple teams.

Nice to Have & Culture

  • Some familiarity with AWS; used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies Ledn values.
  • Builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Remote-first environment with global team.
  • Purpose-driven career and inclusive, diverse culture. Equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests can be made confidentially.

Other Information

  • Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Our growth is real - we are a billion-dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world. Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our growing data team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines and architectures on Azure, while working with a variety of analytics and data integration tools. This role will be instrumental in supporting data-driven decision-making across multiple business units by ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and efficient.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows to support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.

  • Implement and manage dbt (Data Build Tool) transformations to create modular, testable, and maintainable data models.

  • Optimize and manage data warehouses and data lakes to support reporting, analytics, and machine learning workloads.

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security across the entire data ecosystem.

  • Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability and data integrity.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake, Functions, Logic Apps).

  • Expertise in SQL and experience with Azure SQL and SQL Server.

  • Experience implementing Debezium for CDC pipelines.

  • Proficiency with dbt for data modeling and transformation.

  • Strong knowledge of Snowflake including performance tuning, schema design, and data loading.

  • Experience working with multiple site analytics data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, etc.).

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modeling, and ETL/ELT best practices.

  • Proficiency in Python programming language for data processing.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is a highly motivated, dependable technologist who wants to be part of a fast moving and execution-oriented team.

The role involves designing, implementing and managing our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks; collaborating with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR); and being a strong communicator and fast learner in a supportive environment for IT growth. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Overview

You will be customer-facing, the first line of support, own support, and provide an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We primarily work on Mac environments. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment and will own the onboarding and offboarding tech experience. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management. You will work on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.), document solutions, and automate routine tasks. You will manage incidents, juggle help desk tickets, and participate in projects over sprints with Jira and Agile methods. You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own the employee technology experience (Mac-focused environment).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding processes.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base.
  • Manage SaaS applications: Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Administer Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Manage identity and access, IDP/SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear solutions and help articles; automate routine tasks.
  • Lead and participate in projects with Agile methods and Jira tracking.
  • Handle critical incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets effectively.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and cross-functional teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations (bash, zsh, Python) and use open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; API integration between systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; ability to convey ideas clearly and empathetically.
  • Security awareness, basic networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching) and OSI troubleshooting methodology.

Benefits & Culture

Buscamos pessoas inovadoras, comprometidas, curiosas, apaixonadas por pessoas e pela educação para integrar a equipe.

O desafio:

Você será um dos pioneiros na estruturação de processos, governança e ferramentas de Analytics Engineering na Fluency, impactando milhares de alunos e empresas parceiras. Atuaremos em um ambiente descentralizado, onde times de BI, Ciência de Dados e Analytics estão espalhados em diferentes áreas, exigindo colaboração horizontal e protagonismo técnico.

Inscreva-se e conheça mais sobre o nosso time.

Main responsibilities

Construir a Fundação de Dados

  • Projetar e implementar modelos de dados escaláveis no BigQuery (GCP), garantindo integração com sistemas legados (AWS: Redshift, S3, Glue) durante a migração;
  • Criar pipelines de dados (ELT/ETL) com Fivetran, Dataflow e Airflow/Composer para consolidar fontes heterogêneas (dados proprietários e conexão com bases externas via APIs);
  • Definir padrões de qualidade, documentação e versionamento para tabelas bronze, silver e gold;

Governança & Autoatendimento

  • Estabelecer práticas de governança de dados em um ambiente descentralizado, garantindo que times de marketing, produtos, vendas, operações e outros tenham acesso seguro a métricas confiáveis;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas de autoatendimento (ex: modelos semantic layer no Dataform) para reduzir a dependência de queries complexas em áreas não técnicas;

Colaboração Horizontal

  • Apoiar o time de Data Analytics no fornecimento de dados curados para métricas de engajamento (ex: progresso de alunos em cursos de idiomas + tecnologia) e com time de Marketing/Sales para métricas de aquisição;
  • Trabalhar com times de Ciência de Dados para operacionalizar modelos de ML;
  • Integrar dados de múltiplas áreas, enriquecendo bases e garantindo consistência e qualidade dos dados;

Data-Driven Culture

description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar a hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, CIPA, CCIH, Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da sua equipe de enfermagem orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão leito a leito, passando ou recebendo os pacientes, com os prontuários em ordem: impressos identificados, medicação verificada, artigos com data de trocas em dia, exames realizados e anotações claras, conferência de materiais do setor e expurgo limpo e organizado;
  • Realizar a cada plantão, registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe presente, preenchendo o check list (materiais permanentes e controle de pacientes), anotando as intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Ler o Livro de Ocorrências diariamente;
  • Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e garantir a abertura das Notificações do NSP;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) para pacientes que irão internar e permanecer por mais de 6 horas no setor, antes de ser encaminhado ao setor de internação;
  • Assistir ao paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas afetadas, promovendo condições adequadas para seu repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar os procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro, como curativos, cateterismos vesical, sondagem vesical, nasogástrica e nasoentérico, não podendo ser delegado aos técnicos, lembrando-se de registrar tudo corretamente na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada, observando que sejam obedecidos todos os cuidados;
  • Preparar e instalar os drippings dos pacientes, delegando essa função à equipe técnica somente na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar aos setores responsáveis, pedido de exames e autorização de materiais especiais, devidamente protocolados;
  • Informar ao médico plantonista as intercorrências que venham a ocorrer com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;
  • Atender situações de urgência e emergência, identificando sinais de deterioração clínica;
  • Chamar equipe médica e fisioterapeuta para o atendimento e situações emergenciais; com o médico na realização de exames e tratamentos;
  • Dar informação ao paciente quanto à terapêutica e os exames solicitados;
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar corretamente a identificação do paciente;

description:
ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Realizar avaliações com equipe multiprofissional, emitir laudos e encaminhamentos para crianças com suspeita de autismo;

Realizar avaliação, triagem e encaminhamento para as terapias necessárias para os pacientes das reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Auxiliar na construção do Projeto Terapêutico Singular dos pacientes, a ser desenvolvido por equipe multiprofissional;

Prescrever medicamentos e realizar os ajustes necessários das dosagens para os pacientes absorvidos pelas reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Realizar consultas de acompanhamento para os pacientes das reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Realizar renovação de laudos;

Evoluir os atendimentos em prontuário eletrônico.

Ensino Superior em Medicina;

Residência ou título de especialista em neurologia pediátrica;

title: KF - Manual Tester - 190
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Manual Tester to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in ensuring the quality and reliability of our applications by verifying functionality against detailed specifications. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in the software development lifecycle by designing, executing, and managing comprehensive manual test plans and cases. Working closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts, the Senior Manual Tester will help deliver robust, defect-free software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Building, modifying, and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and scripts to validate application functionality. This includes covering both positive and negative scenarios to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Identifying, reporting, and tracking defects through to closure using Azure DevOps Test Plan features. Collaborate with development teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Actively participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Review requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and testability.
  • Work closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts to understand business needs and technical requirements, ensuring alignment and quality delivery.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports to support transparency and traceability.
  • Perform thorough manual testing to validate new features and existing functionality, ensuring the software meets business and technical requirements.
  • While primarily focused on manual testing, understand automated test script execution and results to complement manual efforts and improve overall test coverage.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Contribute to process improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and best practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • SQL: Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to validate data integrity and support backend testing. Ability to analyze and manipulate data sets to verify application behavior.
  • Oracle PL/SQL: Strong experience with Oracle PL/SQL for database testing, including writing and executing stored procedures, functions, and triggers to validate business logic at the database level.
  • Microsoft Excel: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, particularly with functions like VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, to analyze test data, compare results, and generate reports efficiently.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Test Plan features for managing test cases, executing tests, logging defects, and tracking progress within an Agile environment.
  • Manual Testing: Expertise in manual functional testing, including designing test cases, executing tests, and validating application features against requirements.
  • Functional Testing: Deep understanding of functional testing principles to ensure that software behaves as expected under various conditions.
  • Scrum: Active participation in Agile Scrum ceremonies, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the ability to work effectively in iterative development cycles.
  • Defect Management: Skilled in identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects to resolution, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ultra Edit: Familiarity with Ultra Edit or similar advanced text editors to review and analyze code snippets, logs, or configuration files during testing.
  • PeopleSoft HCM: Experience with PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, understanding core modules and workflows to better test related applications.
  • Benefits Module: Knowledge of Benefits modules within PeopleSoft or similar HR systems to validate features related to employee benefits administration.
  • Payroll Module: Understanding of Payroll modules and processes to effectively test payroll-related functionalities and integrations.

Overview

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US? At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers. We turn audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and relentless optimization. If you’re a Machine Learning Engineer with a passion for bridging technical expertise and business acumen, and you thrive in building scalable, reliable systems that directly move revenue, we’d love to have you join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of advertising algorithms, personalization, and optimization—building the ML software and infrastructure that drives ad performance and user engagement at scale.

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of software development and ML engineering, including 3+ years focused on advertising systems
  • Proven experience optimizing ad performance using both mature models and emerging ML technologies
  • Expertise in one or more ML areas: Recommendation Systems, Advertising Algorithms, NLP, or CV
  • Proficiency with Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Familiarity with distributed data processing (Spark, Ray) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a proven track record of delivering measurable results
  • Excellent communication, teamwork, and project management skills

Your Role

Your mission: Elevate Launch Potato’s advertising performance by building scalable, production-ready ML systems that optimize revenue while enhancing user experience. You’ll collaborate across teams to design, deploy, and refine algorithms that improve ad targeting, relevance, and efficiency at global scale.

Outcomes

  • Develop and scale advertising algorithms that optimize engagement and revenue simultaneously
  • Apply cutting-edge ML approaches (e.g., reinforcement learning, deep learning for ranking) to improve ad performance
  • Build scalable infrastructure to support real-time ad decisioning across millions of requests per day
  • Conduct rigorous experiments (A/B and multivariate tests) to measure model impact on business KPIs
  • Continuously improve ETL pipelines and monitoring systems to ensure reliable ad delivery
  • Collaborate with global teams across product, data, and engineering to launch high-impact ad features
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and integrate them into our ML stack when they create competitive advantage

Competencies

  • Impact-Oriented: You align ML systems to business outcomes and measure what matters
  • Technical Builder: You write clean, production-ready code and architect scalable systems
  • Collaborative: You work seamlessly with global teams and communicate complex ideas clearly
  • Resilient & Determined: You don’t shy from challenges and drive projects through to impact
  • Curious Innovator: You keep pace with ML/AI trends and creatively apply them to advertising
  • Analytical Problem-Solver: You break down complex systems and find data-driven solutions

We are committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Ability to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.
  • Experience in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package from day one.
  • Competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, contact the Ledn team by email. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients — in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combating these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to do work more efficiently.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • Remote work eligibility: up to 180 days work-from-anywhere per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job and a culture that removes barriers so you love what you do.

Working Environment & Equal Opportunity

Ledn is truly global with employees across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote-first environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Resumo da vaga

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA , proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e carinho com seus processos de trabalho.

Principais atividades

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar a hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e da instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, CIPA, CCIH, Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor, buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da equipe de enfermagem, orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão, leito a leito, com prontuários em ordem, incluindo itens como identificação, medicação verificada, alterações de material, exames realizados e anotações claras;
  • Realizar a cada plantão o registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe, preenchendo o checklist, anotando intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Ler o Livro de Ocorrências diariamente;
  • Assegurar conformidade com as metas do NSP (Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente) e abrir Notificações quando houver não conformidades;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o SAE para pacientes que permanecerão por mais de 6 horas no setor, antes de encaminhar para internação;
  • Abordar o paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas, promovendo condições adequadas para repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro (curativos, cateterismo vesical, sondagens vesical e nasogástrica/nasoentérica), registrando tudo na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada e aos cuidados necessários;
  • Preparar e instalar drips, delegando para a equipe técnica apenas na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar exames e autorizar materiais especiais aos setores responsáveis, conforme protocolo;
  • Informar ao médico plantonista as intercorrências ocorridas com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;
  • Atender situações de urgência e emergência, identificando sinais de deterioração clínica;
  • Chamar equipe médica e fisioterapeuta para atendimento e situações emergenciais, com o médico no acompanhamento de exames e tratamentos;
  • Dar informações ao paciente quanto à terapêutica e aos exames solicitados;
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar a identificação do paciente;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o setor de Radiologia e assisti-lo durante a realização de todo o exame;
  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento do paciente até o Centro Cirúrgico, se houver necessidade de intervenção cirúrgica;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o quarto no momento da alta para a Unidade de Internação/Centro de Terapia Intensiva, passando o plantão para o integrante da equipe de enfermagem responsável.

  • Nível superior em Enfermagem
  • Desejável experiência de 6 meses na função
  • Especialização na área de Emergência
  • Mediação de conflitos, procedimentos de enfermagem BLS, ACLS
  • Pacote Office

  • Salário R$ 4.100,00 - PJ
