description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN . Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Ledn’s team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s products and services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • You will be customer-facing, the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll juggle help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in Jira (agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and align them to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS and experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We look for a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and opportunities for growth. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Working Environment

  • Ledn is global and remote-first. Our people span North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing, the first line of support; own support, and provide an outstanding support experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.

  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.

Application and Environment

title: Finance Transformation Automation Associate
description:
Finance Transformation Automation Associate

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

For more about dLocal, check our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Ledn’s core values are act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are remote-first and support a diverse, global team.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate will wear many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and be able to adapt to a fast-moving, security-first environment. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the employee tech experience via Slack, Jira, and other tools. Responsibilities include procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and provisioning tech for outgoing staff. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoints and MDM/EMM tools. You will also work on identity and access management (IDP/SSO with G Suite, Okta), document solutions, and automate routine tasks.

You will manage incidents, prioritize help desk tickets, and collaborate across teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR). You will work in sprints with Jira and align your objectives and key results with team and company goals.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own the employee tech experience (Mac-centric environment).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding hardware responsibilities.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs and policies; contribute to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications: Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management (MDM/EMM) tools (Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tooling (GSuite, Okta); integrate systems via APIs.
  • Troubleshoot, respond to incidents, and manage help desk tickets with prioritization.
  • Participate in project work over sprints with Agile practices (Jira).
  • Set and pursue own objectives and key results aligned with company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS benchmarks, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO and workflows in Okta; API experience for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong security consciousness and understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Self-management: ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf or Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Experience in a remote, high-growth startup or tech environment; collaborative, empathetic partner across functions.

Benefits & Environment

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and equity opportunities.
  • Remote-friendly with up to 180 days of remote work worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse workplace with equal opportunity employment principles.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn’s team is global and remote-first; short-listed candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and public social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes or fees.

Nós somos a Fisia, a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil. Integramos o ecossistema do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas. Somos guardiões de uma marca que está presente no dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no mundo todo. Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça. Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

A pessoa que ocupa a função de Consultor de Vendas é a peça chave do nosso time, pois o campo tem que estar organizado para o jogo acontecer! É a pessoa que vai encantar o nosso cliente e garantir uma experiência inesquecível em nossa loja.

  • Habilidade com organização e reposição de produtos
  • Disponibilidade de horário (período tarde/noite)

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar.

Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para.

Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsibilities

Cumprir as rotinas determinados pela a área de Enfermagem, quando referente ao acompanhamento e condução de pacientes.

Ensino Médio completo

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Overview

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Nós somos a Fisia, a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil. Integramos o ecossistema do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas. Somos guardiões de uma marca que está presente no dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no mundo todo. Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça. Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

Sobre a posição

A pessoa que ocupa a função de Consultor de Vendas é a peça chave do nosso time, pois o campo tem que estar organizado para o jogo acontecer! É a pessoa que vai encantar o nosso cliente e garantir uma experiência inesquecível em nossa loja.

  • Atendimento consultivo ao cliente
  • Excelência no atendimento
  • Fidelização dos clientes
  • Garantir uma ótima experiência de compra ao cliente
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos e tendências de moda esportiva
  • Resultados e indicadores individuais de vendas (conversão e ticket médio)
  • Ser guardião da marca Nike!

O que você precisa para essa posição

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência anterior com vendas em lojas varejistas
  • Habilidade com organização e reposição de produtos
  • Disponibilidade de horário (período tarde/noite)
  • Vontade de aprender e de crescer

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar.

Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para.

Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Job


Draiver is an industry-leading self-learning logistics platform that enables vehicle movement planning, coordination, and execution. We connect businesses to transport services and independent contract drivers, providing GPS routing, tracking, digital documentation, and payment solutions in one simple application. Our platform empowers companies to streamline operations while drivers gain flexible access to opportunities.


We are looking for a Marketplace Manager to play a pivotal role at the intersection of operations and product. This person will oversee the growth and health of our driver marketplace, ensuring we deliver the best experience for drivers and partners, while collaborating closely with product and engineering to shape platform improvements.


This is a unique opportunity to manage dynamic multi-country markets, drive measurable business impact, and influence the roadmap of a global gig-economy platform.


What You’ll Do



  • Own marketplace performance across supply and demand, identifying opportunities to improve driver engagement, retention, and efficiency.

  • Work cross-functionally with product, operations, data, and business development teams to design and execute strategies that scale sustainably.

  • Collaborate with product management to define requirements and prioritize features that improve marketplace balance, transparency, and user experience.

  • Launch and optimize new markets, setting up operational frameworks, KPIs, and success metrics.

  • Monitor performance data to detect trends, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to driver onboarding, trip allocation, pricing, and compliance processes.

  • Act as a bridge between marketplace realities and product development, ensuring product decisions are informed by operational insights.

  • Build business cases for new initiatives and drive projects end-to-end, from ideation to execution.

  • Partner with local teams and leadership across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, and other markets to align strategies and share best practices.


Basic Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in marketplace operations, product management, consulting, or a similar data-driven role.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure problems, interpret data, and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work across countries and cultures.

  • Hands-on mentality with resilience, adaptability, and a bias toward execution.

  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and comfort with data tools.


Bonus Points If



  • You have direct experience managing a two-sided marketplace or gig economy platform.

  • You have technical skills in SQL, Python, or dashboarding tools (e.g. Superset).

  • You bring product management or product operations experience, especially in defining requirements and working with engineering/design teams.

  • You have working proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese.


Why Join Draiver


At Draiver, you’ll be at the core of a global company that is transforming vehicle logistics. You’ll gain exposure to multiple markets, work with a diverse international team, and directly shape the evolution of our platform. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving complex marketplace challenges, and wants to grow as both a business and product leader.

description:
Job description

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!

Somos uma consultoria de inovação e transformação digital e buscamos Design Lead para fazer parte dessa jornada.

Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Main responsibilities

Coordenador(a)/Lead de Design responsável por assegurar a qualidade técnica do produto digital e demonstrar, com evidências, o impacto do design nos resultados do negócio. Atuará de forma integrada aos times de Produto e Tecnologia, conduzindo a experiência de ponta a ponta — da concepção à entrega — com coerência entre jornadas, interfaces, estados e conteúdo, e registrando comparativos “antes/depois” que sustentem decisões executivas.

  • Liderar e orientar um time de designers, planejando capacidade, prioridades e removendo impedimentos.
  • Garantir a qualidade do design em todo o ciclo (discovery à entrega), incluindo arquitetura de informação, fluxos com corte vertical, microinterações, tratamento de erros e estados vazios.
  • Assegurar a aplicação consistente do Design System (tokens, variantes, guidelines), governança de contribuições e prevenção de regressões.
  • Zelar pela acessibilidade, incluindo requisitos regulatórios quando aplicável.
  • Direcionar atividades de pesquisa (sem execução direta), conectando achados a decisões de design e evolução do backlog.
  • Conduzir críticas de design, definir critérios de qualidade (“quality gates”) e promover consistência entre iniciativas e squads.
  • Articular decisões com Produto e Engenharia, apresentando raciocínio, protótipos e evidências que sustentem escolhas técnicas e de experiência.
  • Documentar e apresentar resultados com comparativos “antes/depois” (ex.: redução de atritos, erros e etapas; aumento de completude de tarefas; diminuição de chamados de suporte).

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança ou coordenação de times de design de produto/serviço.
  • Excelência técnica em UX/UI: arquitetura de informação, design de interação, design visual, microinterações e padrões de conteúdo.
  • Domínio de Figma (auto-layout, variants, design tokens) e boas práticas de handoff para Engenharia.
  • Vivência com Design System em produto vivo (versionamento, contribuição e gestão de estados críticos).
  • Capacidade de demonstrar impacto de design no negócio por meio de evidências objetivas de “antes/depois”.
  • Familiaridade com DesignOps (ritmos, governança, critérios de qualidade) e condução de críticas de design.
  • Conhecimento aplicado de acessibilidade (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Comunicação clara para articular trade-offs com Produto e Tecnologia e defender decisões de forma estruturada.

Diferenciais

  • Casos públicos que evidenciem melhoria de experiência com foco no negócio.
  • Experiência em evolução de Design System em escala e colaboração próxima com times de front-end.
  • Vivência em service design/omnichannel (blueprints e políticas de exceção).
  • Formação complementar em Estratégia/Produto/Negócios e domínio de frameworks de narrativa executiva.

Additional information

  • Tecnologia

Nossa Paixão por tecnologia nos impulsiona a modernizar e acelerar negócios;

  • Transparência e Comprometimento:

Somos guiados pela transparência e comprometimento com a entrega;

  • Conexão Humana:

Somos humanos que escutam com empatia e colaboram nas diferenças;

Construímos nossa reputação nos desafiando diariamente para entregar as melhores experiências para nossos clientes e colaboradores;

É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.

Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

  • Atuar como ponte entre times de negócio, segurança e engenharia, garantindo adoção e alinhamento corporativo.

Liderança Técnica

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

4 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll juggle help desk tickets and prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to be certified).
  • You have used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $30 billion group transportation industry with cutting-edge technology and innovative SaaS software, delivering an industry-leading experience for both customers and operators. Trusted by most Fortune 500 companies, our platform connects users to thousands of charter bus and minibus operators nationwide. In just 60 seconds, customers can access real-time availability, transparent pricing, and detailed vehicle options—whether organizing a corporate event, a company shuttle, or a wedding. By streamlining what was once a fragmented and stressful process, CharterUP brings transparency, accountability, and efficiency to an industry overdue for innovation. With CharterUP, group transportation is no longer a hassle but an elevated, reliable experience. Join us as we lead the future of group travel.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUP has achieved growth, profitability, and stability.

About the Role

Senior Product Designer to lead the design of a new, high-impact product within our growing mobility platform. This role blends UX strategy, visual design, and product thinking—from user research and usability testing to building intuitive, production-ready interfaces in Figma. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers, helping shape a cohesive design system and elevating the overall product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work in a startup-paced environment, where your ideas will directly influence product direction and user satisfaction.

Title: Senior Product Designer

Reports to: Chief Product Officer

What You’ll Do

  • Design from Discovery to Delivery: Conduct user research and usability testing, translate insights into wireframes and prototypes, and ship elegant, production-ready designs.
  • Own the Visual System: Create scalable, consistent design components in Figma, contributing to and expanding our design system.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product managers, engineers, and other designers to define problems, explore solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Champion the User: Bring a user-first mindset to ensure designs are functional, accessible, and visually cohesive across platforms.
  • Contribute to Culture: Collaborate with the broader design team (4+ designers plus UX lead) to evolve design standards, processes, and best practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on product design experience spanning UI and UX for web or mobile applications.
  • Figma Expertise: Deep proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, prototyping, and collaborative workflows.
  • Product Mindset: Proven success designing within software development environments, collaborating closely with engineers and PMs.
  • User-Centric Skills: Strong background in usability testing, user interviews, and turning insights into thoughtful design solutions.
  • Portfolio Quality: Work that demonstrates polished, interaction-focused design for complex digital products.
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (written and spoken).
  • Work Ethic: Startup mentality — proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Nice-to-Have: Experience designing for B2B, logistics, or other complex system-driven products.

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built-in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

title: Analista de auditoria senior
description:
Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Estruturar e Executar o Plano de Auditoria Integrada: Mapear processos ponta a ponta (financeiros, operacionais e de TI) para avaliar a adequação e a eficácia dos controles internos com base nos frameworks COSO (controles internos) e COBIT (governança de TI), com foco especial nos fluxos transacionais e de configuração operados no SAP B1.
  • Conduzir Testes de Controles e Substantivos: Desenvolver e executar programas de testes de auditoria para avaliar a integridade dos registros contábeis e a segurança dos sistemas de informação. Isso inclui a condução de testes de Controles Gerais de TI (ITGCs), a validação da conformidade das configurações e a análise de dados para identificar anomalias.
  • Reportar Achados e Acompanhar Planos de Ação: Elaborar relatórios de auditoria claros e objetivos, comunicando as deficiências identificadas, os riscos associados e as recomendações de melhoria para a alta gestão. Atuar em parceria com as áreas de negócio para desenvolver e acompanhar a implementação dos planos de ação.
  • Atuar como Consultor de Riscos e Controles: Servir como um consultor interno para as áreas de negócio e tecnologia, oferecendo suporte na análise de riscos de novos projetos, processos e sistemas, garantindo que os controles sejam desenhados de forma eficaz desde a concepção (compliance and security by design).

Requisitos

  • Experiência Híbrida em Auditoria: Sólida experiência em auditoria interna ou externa, com vivência comprovada tanto em auditoria de processos contábeis e financeiros (ciclo de receita, despesas, fechamento) quanto em auditoria de sistemas e Controles Gerais de TI (ITGC).
  • Domínio de Frameworks de Controle: Profundo conhecimento teórico e prático nos frameworks de controle interno e governança de TI, especialmente COSO (Estrutura Integrada de Controles Internos) e COBIT (para processos de TI).
  • Conhecimento em ERP e Processos Contábeis: Excelente base de conhecimento contábil (princípios, conciliações, relatórios) e experiência prática com sistemas ERP, com destaque para o SAP B1, entendendo seus módulos, tabelas e fluxos de dados.
  • Perfil Analítico e Comunicação Efetiva: Perfil crítico, detalhista e com alta capacidade analítica para conectar informações de diferentes fontes e identificar a causa raiz dos problemas. Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar achados complexos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Pontos a mais se você possui

  • Habilidades em Análise de Dados (CAATs): Domínio de ferramentas e linguagens para Testes de Auditoria Assistidos por Computador, como bancos de dados SQL para extração e manipulação de grandes volumes de informação e Python para automação de testes e análises.
  • Conhecimento em Normas Contábeis Específicas: Familiaridade com planos de contas setoriais, como o COSIF, e conhecimento em regulamentações de privacidade de dados (LGPD) e segurança da informação (ISO 27001).
  • Certificações Profissionais: Possuir certificações na área de auditoria, como CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) ou outras correlatas.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Se nós crescemos, nossos Qivers também vem com a gente! Temos um Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

You will own the end-user experience, provisioning and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding with secure offboarding procedures. You will manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, etc.), Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools, and IDP/SSO integrations.

You will collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR) and work in an environment that values automation, rapid iteration, and strong communication.   • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate clearly across multiple channels and cultures.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).

  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Proficiency with networking fundamentals, OSI model troubleshooting, and enterprise macOS management.
  • Self-management with the ability to scope projects, prioritize, and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Have

description:
MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO GERAL - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Prestar atendimento aos pacientes de acordo com a demanda, efetuando, exame físico e hipótese diagnóstica, encaminhando o paciente a exames complementares quando necesario e realizando os procedimentos cirúrgicos indicados, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro do princípio ético da profissão.

Ensino Superior completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable, creative in problem solving, and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We predominantly work on macOS, and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools. You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix incidents as needed. You will work on projects over sprints, and document your work in Jira. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of API integrations between systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear, friendly, and concise writing.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, macOS enterprise configuration, and technical onboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with clear scoping of projects and priorities across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : You thrive in a startup/tech environment, value integrity and accountability, and can influence across functions with empathy and clarity. Experience working in a remote environment is a plus.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, competitive PTO, ownership in the company through equity, and remote work opportunities worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). We aim to remove barriers so you can love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing the Ledn team throughout all stages of the recruitment process; requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Job Details

  • Seniority level : Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type : Full-time
  • Job function : Information Technology
  • Industries : Retail

title: Senior Drilling Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Drilling Engineer role at bp

Sub-Discipline: Engineering

Specialism: Engineering – Senior Drilling Engineer

Primary Reporting: Wells Discipline Lead

Role Synopsis

The Senior Drilling Engineer (SDE) will be responsible for engineering activities to efficiently design, plan, and support execution of wells in Brazil in accordance with all local laws and bp practices. The SDE will work with a multi-disciplinary and international team to ensure safe delivery of all business objectives for the wells. This includes addressing safety and operational risks, progressing engineering work and procedures through assurance steps, providing engineering support to the Wells Superintendent (WSUP), and mentoring less experienced staff.

Essential Role Requirements

Experience: Significant drilling engineering experience, preferably in deepwater with an operator. Experience working within, and preferably supervising, multi-disciplinary teams.

Qualifications: Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate at all levels to efficiently manage multi-disciplinary scopes of work.

Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF)

BOSIET or HUET training for locations requiring helicopter transit to the Wellsite.

Education: Bachelor in an Engineering field or higher.

Fluent in English. Fluent in Portuguese.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

In this role the SDE will:

  • Provide engineering experience and expertise for well design, well planning, and preparation of wells programs that safely and compliantly conform to well objectives, leading these activities through assurance (e.g., tubular design, cementing and fluids design, well placement design, AFE preparation, risk register management, equipment readiness, program readiness).
  • Support the WSUP and Operations Team before and during the execution of wells by delivering high level drilling engineering leadership, support, and assurance.
  • Provide leadership for the day-to-day management of drilling operations and be accountable for aspects of performance (HSSE, People Agenda, and Financial Delivery) from planning to implementation and assurance.
  • Continually review drilling operations performance, identify lessons learned, and lead continuous improvement in performance and process optimisation in line with function practices and policies.
  • Identify and share global and local takeaways through collaboration with key internal partners and develop themes from issues and incidents, codifying related lessons into standards and technical practices.
  • Identify, mitigate, document, and convey wells safety risks to key partners (e.g., HAZOPs, Risk Assessments, MOCs).
  • Provide engineering expertise to support Subsurface, Projects, Finance, Vendors, and Regional collaborators.
  • Model bp values through work with a large, diverse, multi-functional team, promoting inclusion and growing capability in self and others.
  • Ensure personal and team compliance with BP’s Code of Conduct and demonstrate a commitment to safety and bp’s Who We Are framework.
  • Coach and develop others to improve leadership capability, delivery of business objectives, and a high-performance culture.

Key Competencies

  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Discipline Specific: Life of Well Design, Equipment Integrity Assurance, Well Integrity, Well Control, Well Performance, Tubular Handling & Installation, Cementing, Wellhead and Tree Installation, Directional Drilling and Surveying techniques.

Development & Training

  • Provide support and coaching to ensure safe and efficient planning/execution of activities.
  • Mentor and supervise the development of less experienced engineering staff.

Leadership & Behavioural Traits

  • Proactively lives BP values, including Code of Conduct
  • Informed Judgment: Uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe and reliable wells; knows when to raise issues or seek help.
  • Commitment and Engagement: Demonstrates personal commitment to delivering the plan and continuous improvement
  • Systematic Management: Applies OMS to planning and operations
  • Leadership Presence: Demonstrates courage to safely handle risk
  • Accountability: Ensures safety compliance and performance expectations are clear and delivered
  • Standout Colleague: Enables others to reach their potential
  • Safety Leader: Serves as a role model for safety
  • Good Communication Skills: Able to connect with diverse teams

Key Relationships

The Senior Drilling Engineer will be part of the P&O Wells Team Organization for the Regions Group (Brazil). The SDE will collaborate with the Discipline Lead and other Brazil engineering team members, and work with Operations, contractors, and well service personnel in office and on site. Key relationships include well planning service providers, PSCM/Logistics, Exploration/New Well Delivery, Completions Engineering, Well Test, Interventions, and Integrity teams. The Wells Operations team is based in Rio de Janeiro, with related finance, procurement, and logistics support in Rio. The current drilling engineering team is based in Houston and London.

Other key collaborators in Houston include parts of the Brazilian subsurface team and elements of the finance, logistics, and procurement teams.

Desirable Criteria & Qualifications

  • Experience constructing exploration/appraisal/development wells in Brazil
  • Significant drilling engineering experience, preferably in deepwater with an operator

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

Role responsibilities

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
  • You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

  • You will be an excellent communicator and fast learner in a supportive environment to grow IT skills.

About the role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are proficient at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. Responsibilities include procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding and offboarding employees, and documenting programs, policies and tools. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.). You’ll contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.), detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork. Manage incidents, prioritize help desk tickets, and work on projects over sprints with Jira.

You Bring

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; work with APIs and integrate systems; remote support across time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; ability to write clearly in tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing with cultural sensitivity; desire to provide a magical experience; solid security practices; knowledge of PGP; networking fundamentals; OSI model troubleshooting; self-management and multi-team prioritization.

Nice to have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; use of GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

We are looking for a leader who thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder's mindset, be collaborative, and demonstrate integrity and accountability in handling confidential information. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly options, and ownership through equity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests during the recruitment process.

Company & Process

Ledn is remote-first with teams across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume, not all applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and public social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited resumes.
