title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Senior Technical Recruiter - Frontier AI (LATAM)
description:
Overview

Join one of the world’s most ambitious AI technology companies, shaping the future of Sports, Media, and Entertainment. Proximity Works helps global brands discover high-impact AI use cases, build transformative tech stacks, and scale to hundreds of millions of users. Since 2019, Proximity Works has created and scaled AI-driven products used by 697 million daily users, generating $73.5 billion in enterprise value for our partners. We are a global team headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Los Angeles, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore. We partner with some of the biggest names in sports, media, and entertainment, solving complex problems with cutting-edge AI.

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Technical Recruiter who will individually own the end-to-end closure of frontier AI, ML, and backend roles. This is not a traditional TA manager role. It is a high-impact recruiting position requiring technical fluency, first principles sourcing, and persuasive outreach. You will identify, engage, and close exceptional global talent who will help Proximity build world-class AI products and engineering platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end closure of senior AI, ML, multimodal, backend, and engineering hires globally.
  • Build adjacency maps of companies, labs, and communities working on relevant frontier problems.
  • Generate technical screening prompts, knockout questions, and rubrics independently.
  • Source beyond LinkedIn. Leverage GitHub, arXiv, OSS repos, Kaggle, Twitter, Discord, Substack, niche forums, and micro-communities.
  • Craft and execute compelling outreach campaigns using artifact-first hooks and Proximity’s track record as trusted partners to global sports, media, and entertainment leaders.
  • Drive urgency by compressing interview loops, managing notice-period negotiations and buyouts, and delivering offers quickly.
  • Ensure evidence-backed sourcing with GitHub repos, demos, papers, and talks, while maintaining a world-class candidate experience.

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Proven track record as an individual contributor recruiter, not just a TA manager.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing and closing frontier AI, ML, backend, or engineering talent globally.
  • Strong technical comprehension. Comfortable with transformer fine-tuning, multimodal pipelines involving video, audio, and text, MLOps stacks, scalable backend systems, and related domains.
  • Evidence of artifact-based sourcing such as GitHub repos, OSS contributions, research papers, or competition wins.
  • Experience in persuasive multi-touch outreach campaigns and passive talent conversion.
  • Global exposure and ability to recruit across India, EU, LATAM, or other regions with cost-sensitive hiring strategies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience hiring for early-stage or hypergrowth AI and ML product teams.
  • Success recruiting engineers in video generation, lip-sync, diffusion, audio processing, or real-time streaming.
  • Familiarity with ad-tech hiring at scale (RTB, personalization, streaming infrastructure).
  • Portfolio of outreach copy or campaigns with proven conversion results.

What Success Looks Like

  • 6 to 8 successful frontier hires per quarter across India, EU, and LATAM markets.
  • At least 80 percent of sourced candidates are evidence-backed through OSS, papers, or demos.
  • At least two positive replies per 10 passive outreach attempts.
  • SLA adherence: under 8 hours for feedback loops, under 10 days time-to-offer on urgent roles.
  • Candidate satisfaction NPS of 8 or higher.

Success Traits

Builder’s mindset · High agency · Strategic + hands-on balance · Cultural intelligence · Analytical clarity · Trustworthiness · Growth orientation

Benefits

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join Proximity

  • Competitive compensation aligned with global markets, with remote-first flexibility
  • Best-in-class health coverage
  • Annual global off-sites with Proxonauts from SF, Dubai, India
  • Help build AI/ML products and engineering teams that power global leaders in sports, streaming, and media.
  • Work directly with global CTO offices on frontier AI problem statements that shape the future of entertainment and technology.
  • High autonomy, direct accountability, and global reach.

  • Work with the Project Owner: Translate high-level product strategy into detailed execution plans.
  • Keep everything tracked: 100% of tasks live in our task management system - zero work happens outside the system.
  • Achieve 90%+ quality rate: Your tasks should rarely need revisions because they're complete and clear from the start.

  • 1–2 years in project coordination, product operations, or task management roles.

Nice to have

We move very fast, and things change often. We are leaders in our niche, and this pace is the price we pay to stay on top.

  • You love the intensity of fast-moving teams.
  • You want to see your work create an immediate impact.
  • You're energized by structure and accountability.
  • You're ambitious and want to grow quickly.

This environment is NOT for you if:

  • You prefer slow, predictable 9-to-5 routines.
  • You need constant hand-holding or detailed instructions.
  • You're uncomfortable with change and shifting priorities.

Location

No Live Entertainment, temos o The Town e Lollapalooza Brasil em parceria com a C3. Na área de Conteúdo temos espetáculos originais, como o Uirapuru, o The Town O Musical e o Amazônia Para Sempre. Contratação: Tenured - CLT labour code

Nível: Professional

  • Acompanhar a execução orçamentária, comparando o orçado com o realizado e identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria.

  • Realizar cruzamento de dados e automação de análises financeiras, garantindo acurácia e eficiência nos relatórios.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de controle e reportes financeiros, contribuindo para a otimização de custos e resultados.

  • Tem paixão por música, cultura, arte, entretenimento e consome muitos conteúdos que abordam esses temas em diferentes plataformas/redes.
  • Mão na massa! Gosta de resolver problemas e abrir caminhos para grandes ideias;

  • Tem boa comunicação interpessoal e facilidade em trabalhar com muitas interlocuções.
  • Possui ótima organização e é capaz de acompanhar cronogramas de entregas com atenção a prazos e detalhes.

Processo seletivo

O processo seletivo inclui análise curricular, análise dos documentos marítimos e avaliação médica. Poderemos entrar em contato por telefone para esclarecer quaisquer dúvidas. Após se cadastrar, deverá aguardar o nosso contato.

Boa sorte!

A Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é uma joint venture entre a Wilson Sons e a Ultramar. A Wilson Sons é um dos maiores operadores integrados de serviços marítimos, portuários e de logística do Brasil, com mais 180 anos de experiência. A Ultramar é um grupo chileno com mais de 60 anos de experiência, presença em 15 países e grande experiência em serviços de agenciamento marítimo, apoio portuário, logística e transporte.

Com 23 embarcações, a Wilson Sons Offshore oferece apoio marítimo a plataformas de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás. No trajeto entre as plataformas e os terminais portuários, as embarcações PSV transportam equipamentos, lama de perfuração, tubos, cimento e alimentos, entre outros materiais necessários ao negócio dos clientes da indústria de petróleo e gás, e trazem ao continente os dejetos acumulados nas plataformas. Além disso, a empresa também opera com embarcações LSV.

Trata-se do segmento mais jovem da Wilson Sons: suas atividades foram iniciadas em 2003. Hoje já contamos com uma das maiores e mais modernas frotas em apoio Offshore com bandeira brasileira.

O compromisso da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é continuar investindo para apoiar o crescimento de seus clientes e do Brasil. A meta deste ano frente a este cenário desafiador é a redução dos custos e o aumento de produtividade.

Importante: todas as vagas da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore também estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência.

O processo de recrutamento e seleção na WSUT está em conformidade com as exigências da Lei 13.709/2018 Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, e trata de maneira segura e objetiva os dados pessoais dos candidatos às nossas vagas. As informações enviadas pelos candidatos, por ocasião de sua inscrição em processos seletivos ou envio de currículos para composição de base de talentos, são tratadas única e exclusivamente para o enquadramento em oportunidades de trabalho, busca e contato com o candidato. Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Position Summary

The Senior Scientific Communications Specialist is a professional with scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise, responsible for oversight of staff and client services. The position also provides scientifically accurate and balanced information to internal stakeholders, external healthcare professionals, and consumers in a way that supports business needs; is aligned with regulatory and compliance practices; and is consistent with Medical Affairs and brand team objectives.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Integrate scientific expertise with knowledge of regulatory and compliance guidelines to ensure comprehensive review of materials submitted into the approval process.
  • Create and/or review medical affairs materials and promotional materials.

The Senior Scientific Communications Specialist may also be responsible for the following:

  • Serve as a team lead for 1 or more Clients, therapeutic areas, workstreams, or brands.
  • Coordinate with Client to schedule meetings and training sessions, and ensure that all team members meet all training requirements.
  • Manage and distribute overall workload for a brand or therapeutic area.

  • Serve as key contact for communications between the Client and Med Communications team.

  • Provide medical information support via multiple venues including virtual presentations and medical meeting booth coverage.

Qualifications

  • Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and quickly able to learn new software.

Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

O Magalu é uma das maiores empresas de varejo do Brasil, reconhecida por sua inovação e presença digital. Com mais de 60 anos de história, conecta milhões de clientes por meio das lojas e de uma plataforma multicanal, oferecendo produtos e serviços de qualidade. A empresa investe continuamente em transformação digital, tecnologia e diversidade, criando um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Nós representamos uma macro-área de Data Analytics. Nosso time é dividido por pessoas com perfis variados de dados (Analistas de Dados, Engenheiros de Dados, Cientistas, Business Analytics, etc) e também por pessoas com perfil atuante em Pricing, Finanças, Produto e Planejamento Estratégico. Nossa função é navegar por todas as BU's da vertical (grand chef, plus delivery, aiqfome) e conseguir entregar recomendações de negócios baseadas no que os dados estão nos dizendo, para isso, você estará diariamente em contato com times de Marketing, Vendas, Produto, e Tecnologia.

  • Somos uma área que tem por objetivo evangelizar a cultura de dados e experimentação;
  • Faremos estudos de eficiência, apontaremos caminhos e compartilharemos aprendizados;
  • Somos um time aficcionado pelo nosso usuário: seja ele o fominha, seller, CM, indústria ou fomer;
  • Criaremos uma plataforma de dados robusta, com automatização, dashboards e modelos de AI;
  • Se você precisa fazer a mesma coisa todo dia/semana, você precisa automatiza-la.

Descrição do Cargo

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Liderança na Estratégia e Coleta de Dados: Liderar a identificação, avaliação e extração de dados de fontes complexas e variadas (bancos de dados, APIs, data lakes), definindo as melhores práticas e garantindo a integridade e relevância dos dados para as análises estratégicas.
  • Modelagem e Governança de Dados: Desenvolver e implementar processos robustos de limpeza, transformação e modelagem de dados, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e governança das informações em toda a empresa.
  • Análise Preditiva e Diagnóstica: Conduzir análises complexas, incluindo modelagem estatística, testes de hipóteses e análises preditivas, para diagnosticar tendências, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e prever cenários futuros.
  • Desenvolvimento e Liderança de Dashboards Estratégicos: Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards e relatórios estratégicos para a alta gestão, focando em KPIs que direcionem o desempenho do negócio e facilitem a tomada de decisão em tempo real.
  • Parceria Estratégica com Áreas de Negócio: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico para as lideranças, compreendendo profundamente suas necessidades e traduzindo desafios de negócio em projetos de dados que gerem valor e impacto mensurável.
  • Otimização e Arquitetura de Consultas: Elaborar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em grandes volumes de dados.
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura e performance dos bancos de dados analíticos.
  • Automação e Escalabilidade de Processos: Liderar a automação de pipelines de dados e processos analíticos, utilizando ferramentas de ETL/ELT para aumentar a eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das nossas operações de dados.
  • Comunicação e Influência: Comunicar insights e recomendações de forma clara e persuasiva para audiências diversas, incluindo executivos e stakeholders não técnicos, influenciando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Mentoria e Desenvolvimento da Equipe: Atuar como mentor para analistas de dados júnior e pleno, compartilhando conhecimento, promovendo as melhores práticas e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico e analítico da equipe.
  • Inovação e Pesquisa: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens em análise de dados e machine learning, mantendo a empresa na vanguarda das práticas do mercado.
  • Precisamos Que Você Tenha
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em áreas relacionadas a dados será considerado um diferencial.
  • Proficiência em SQL (MySQL e Google BigQuery): Experiência avançada na criação e otimização de consultas complexas.
  • Conhecimento em Window Functions, CTEs (Common Table Expressions) e boas práticas para performance e controle de custos em ambientes de nuvem.
  • Expertise em Ferramentas de BI (Power BI e Looker Studio): Domínio completo de pelo menos uma das ferramentas (preferencialmente ambas) para criar dashboards complexos, interativos e de alto impacto.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados (DAX no Power BI) e integração de múltiplas fontes de dados.
  • Programação em Python para Análise de Dados: Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experiência na automação de processos, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e integração com APIs.
  • Conhecimento Estatístico Aplicado: Sólida compreensão de conceitos estatísticos e sua aplicação prática em negócios (testes A/B, análise de regressão, testes de hipóteses) para validar resultados e gerar insights mais profundos.
  • Google Workspace (Planilhas e Apresentações): Habilidade para ir além do uso básico, utilizando Google Sheets para análises rápidas e prototipagem, e Google Slides para comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara e persuasiva para a liderança.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos complexos com autonomia.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborativo com times multidisciplinares.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de segurança: projetar e garantir a implementação de arquiteturas de segurança robustas e escaláveis para aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes Multi Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), alinhadas com as melhores práticas de mercado e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar no design seguro de sistemas: trabalhar com Arquitetos de Software e equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar segurança desde as etapas iniciais do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Secure SDLC), realizando análises de ameaças (Threat Modeling) e revisões de design.
  • Garantir a segurança em ambientes Cloud e Contêineres: implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para plataformas Cloud (principalmente GCP, incluindo GKE, Cloud SQL), redes (VPCs, firewalls, micro-segmentação) e ambientes conteinerizados (Kubernetes), assegurando conformidade e proteção de dados.

  • Gerenciar Identidade e Acesso: projetar e implementar soluções de IAM, autenticação forte (MFA, SSO) e gestão de segredos para assegurar o princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Assegurar conformidade e auditoria: atuar para que as soluções estejam em conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas (ex: LGPD, Bacen para clientes do setor financeiro), preparando ambientes para auditorias de segurança.
  • Documentar e disseminar conhecimento: criar e manter documentação técnica de segurança, padrões e guidelines, e atuar como referência para o time em decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Visão estratégica e melhoria contínua: contribuir com a visão estratégica de segurança, identificar tendências e novas ameaças, propondo melhorias para a postura de segurança dos ambientes.

Qualificações / Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Arquitetura de Segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento profundo em plataformas Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), com foco em serviços de segurança nativos (ex: Security Command Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF).
  • Domínio de Kubernetes Security (RBAC, Network Policies, image scanning, runtime security).
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integração de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10, Zero Trust).
  • Conhecimento em IAM, gestão de segredos, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Habilidade para Threat Modeling e análise de riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de segurança (ex: CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GCP Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Experiência em segmentação de rede, VPNs e SD-WAN para ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança como SIEM/SOAR, CSPM e Vulnerability Scanners.
  • Experiência com automação de segurança via scripting (Python, Shell).
  • Histórico de atuação em clientes do setor financeiro e familiaridade com Bacen e LGPD.

O que oferecemos

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Descrição do Cargo:

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de modelos de análise de dados avançados e inteligência artificial no Centro de Monitoramento LIGA. O objetivo é aprimorar a detecção proativa de anomalias, otimizar a manutenção preditiva e apoiar estrategicamente a gestão da confiabilidade e desempenho dos ativos de geração e transmissão da Eletrobras, utilizando insights baseados em dados para minimizar o downtime e estender o ciclo de vida dos ativos.

  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados operacionais (tempo real e históricos) dos ativos monitorados;
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para falhas, degradações de desempenho e eventos críticos;
  • Criar algoritmos e scripts para automatizar detecção de anomalias e alertas inteligentes;
  • Construir dashboards interativos e relatórios analíticos para apoiar a gestão de ativos;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e analistas para interpretar os dados à luz da engenharia de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação Superior completo em Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Estatística, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio em técnicas de Machine Learning, Modelagem Estatística e Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à detecção de anomalias e previsão de falhas;

  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, processamento de dados em tempo real e ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Excelência na criação de dashboards interativos (Power BI) e visualizações voltadas à tomada de decisão;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de dados, pipelines de ETL e ambientes em nuvem (cloud);
  • Experiência em projetos de análise de dados, preferencialmente aplicados à indústria, energia ou manutenção.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Engenharia de Confiabilidade ou Inteligência Artificial Aplicada à Indústria;
  • Conhecimento em Engenharia da Confiabilidade (FMEA, RCM, RAM), ISO 55.000, SAP PM, SCADA e SAGE;
  • Experiência com dados operacionais, modelagem preditiva e integração de sistemas é um diferencial relevante.

Informações adicionais

Na Eletrobras, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida dos nossos profissionais também fazem parte da Nossa Energia. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que promovem o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e as necessidades das equipes. Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role Details

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You'll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to have certifications).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to work efficiently.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, is excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future.
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Our team is global and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade: Mapear riscos, acompanhar auditorias e manter os controles de segurança atualizados, mitigando vulnerabilidades em sistemas, processos e fornecedores;
  • Estratégia de Segurança: Definir e implementar a visão de InfoSec, alinhando práticas de segurança da informação aos objetivos de negócio e compliance (ISO 27001 e LGPD);
  • Resiliência Operacional: Estabelecer planos de resposta a incidentes, post mortems de falhas e priorização de soluções de longo prazo;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Apoiar times de engenharia e produto na definição de soluções resilientes e seguras, garantindo boas práticas em identidade, criptografia, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes;
  • Governança e Políticas: Estruturar e revisar normas, políticas e procedimentos de InfoSec, assegurando sua aplicação em toda a companhia;
  • Integração com o Negócio: Atuar junto a stakeholders internos e externos (clientes, parceiros e auditores) para demonstrar a maturidade do programa de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Tech Manager, Security Lead ou correlata em empresas de tecnologia SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 adiantados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. title: Sr. Loan Workout Relationship Manager
description:
Overview

Location: 127 Public Square, Cleveland Ohio

ABOUT THE JOB
The Sr. Loan Workout Relationship Manager is the most senior level specialized account manager position. This position is responsible for managing a portfolio of accounts with high levels of complexity and will lead all workout activity for assigned accounts. Individuals at this level are fully experienced, qualified workout professionals capable of independently managing large and complex accounts, including highly structured lending arrangements and Agented or Participant loan facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a loan portfolio to mitigate risk with deals consisting of multiple loan types offered by Key Bank and with unlimited complexity and potential for adversarial litigation. Relationships will include accounts with aggregate balances generally above $25MM.
  • Review and analyze loan documentation, financial statements and other similar loan and borrower information to assess risk, quantify repayment capacity, consider the adequacy of repayment sources and/or estimate recovery potential.
  • Develop, recommend and implement workout/liquidation strategies for problem loans including past due, underperforming, non-performing, and charged-off loans to mitigate risk and maximize recovery.
  • Exercise individual delegated approval authority or recommend to higher level approval authority for modifications, payment deferrals, or other actions to resolve assigned accounts
  • Adhere to department and corporate guidelines, policies and compliance procedures.
  • Maintain constructive interaction with clients, work colleagues, lines of business and bank regulators.
  • Work with other professionals such as appraisers, environmental consultants, auctioneers, real estate brokers and property managers to maximize return on collateral secured loans.
  • Work with bank counsel in a cost-effective manner to achieve desired results.
  • Support departmental continuous improvement efforts.
  • Periodically travel to meet with clients or view collateral.
  • Participate in the Quarterly Asset Quality Review process and produce timely documentation as required.
  • Shadow accounts on the line of business which need workout advice.
  • Manage and recommend commercial assets for non-accrual or charge-off disposition as appropriate.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all KeyBank policies and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Business, Finance, or Economics preferred).
  • Min.10 years commercial credit experience (e.g. underwriting, credit risk management, workout, commercial banker)
  • Demonstrated experience in commercial loan workouts
  • Demonstrated regulatory knowledge, understanding and ability to apply accounting, banking laws, required rules and regulations, credit policy, and risk-rating requirements necessary.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct in-depth financial statement analysis required.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability.
  • Demonstrated strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet multiple deadlines and manage a variety of projects with deliverables.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and focus on implementing solutions.
  • Ability to quantify risks and perform objective analyses.
  • Ability to work independently and in teams to resolve issues and solve problems.
  • Competent in standard office productivity programs (MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

Preferred locations for this role are Cleveland, Albany, Buffalo, or Denver. Strong remote candidates based in other U.S. locations may be considered.

This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $112,000 to $150,000 annually depending on location and job-related factors such as level of experience. Compensation for this role also includes eligibility for short-term incentive compensation and deferred incentive compensation subject to individual and company performance.

title: Field Reimbursement Specialist
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere.

Field Reimbursement Specialists (FRSs) are responsible for providing field support for patient access to client’s specified products through interaction with the client’s patient support program and provider customers.

FRSs provide their expertise and advanced skills to resolve complex patient access and provider reimbursement issues and to provide educational services across a variety of healthcare provider sites of care.

FRSs work directly with the provider and their office support staff and commonly interact with other reimbursement and patient support services provided by clients.

Play a vital role in helping patients gain access to life-changing therapies! From oral medications to biosimilars to critical cancer treatments, our associates, with their passion for patients, represent these therapies providing education, coverage, and access solutions to healthcare personnel.

FRSs will plan and engage with customers, leveraging client-approved resources, to educate on access and reimbursement topics relevant to assigned client’s product.

Our teams travel weekly, which could include overnight, to healthcare offices within a designated territory, using their knowledge of coverage, patient assistance, and health policy to educate office staff and break through access issues to ultimately help patients.

Typical Day:

  • Educate provider office staff and practice managers on logistics needed to support client product, including infrastructure needed to support in-office administration.
  • Educate provider office staff with understanding the payers’ coverage management strategies for product, including coding, billing, formulary, prior authorization, and appeal processes.
  • Probe to understand office processes and ability to discern root causes of access or reimbursement issues.
  • Deliver interactive educational presentations at various provider sites of service.
  • Provide information on relevant reimbursement topics related to our client’s products based on client’s approval.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to conduct field-based reimbursement and access support, education, and consultation to key account customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Understands the dynamics of Specialty Pharmacy vs. Specialty Distribution.
  • Broad understanding of the physician buy-and-bill model vs. assignment of benefits to alternate sites of care.
  • Experience in revenue cycle, buy and bill, formulary, benefit investigations, prior authorization, coding, and appeals processes.
  • Deep understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits/policies.
  • Live within a reasonable commuting distance of a major airport in the listed location and be able to travel within a territory that includes but may not be limited to MN, WI, IL.

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree or specific Practice Management experience preferred.
  • Project management skills.
  • Experience with extensive travel.

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day.

title: Risk Manager
description:
OneOncology is positioning community oncologists to drive the future of cancer care through a patient-centric, physician-driven, and technology-powered model to help improve the lives of everyone living with cancer. Our team is bringing together leaders to the market place to help drive OneOn Oncology’s mission and vision.

Why join us? This is an exciting time to join OneOncology. Our values-driven culture reflects our startup enthusiasm supported by industry leaders in oncology, technology, and finance. We are looking for talented and highly-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to improve and build new processes that support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients they serve.

Job Description

The Risk Manager is responsible for the day-to-day risk management activities for designated United Urology Group-affiliated practices, including investigating, managing, and analyzing risk management data; complying with risk management standards of AAAHC, other accrediting agencies, and local State Department of Health; and conducting risk management educational programs. The Risk Manager coordinates and investigates patient and visitor events, documents all related data, and facilitates resolution of reported incidents. This role supports the UUG-affiliated practice’s objective of enhancing and promoting patient safety and quality of care and minimizing loss to protect the assets of the facility. The individual partakes in formulating risk reduction strategies, policies and/or organizational changes.

Responsibilities

  • Promotes positive collaboration with other members of the Risk Management team to support the overall growth and development of the UUG Risk Management program.
  • Coordinates assigned risk management programs to meet local practice needs.
  • Contributes to the identification, planning, and drafting of Risk Management and Safety Policies and Procedures.
  • Engages in weekly Risk Management team huddles by providing regular updates and input into collaborative problem-solving endeavors.
  • Performs review and analysis of all risk event reports for Risk Management, quality of care, regulatory and insurance concerns utilizing RMIS technology.
  • Utilizes RMIS to manage, document, and store relevant risk management information.

Incidents and Events

  • Communicates importance and encourages the use of incident reporting system to regional providers and staff.
  • Supports a Just Culture reporting environment and supports all quality and safety projects.
  • Completes investigation of reportable events, including chart review, and ensures that all regulatory reporting has been appropriately completed.
  • Guides operations and nursing regarding optimal risk mitigation strategies following events.
  • Moderates Root Cause Analysis investigations, including assessing the need for focused or peer reviews.
  • Tracks Action Plans to ensure completion and appropriate review.
  • Prepares various incident summary reports; provides all required documentation for investigations, activities and resolutions related to the reported incident(s).
  • Identifies regional organizational risk through trend analysis of incidents, incident letters, reports, etc.

Claims & Litigation Management

  • Reports incidents and claims to proper insurance carriers within UUG reporting guidelines.
  • Maintains regular status notes on pending claims and litigation within RMIS.
  • Prepares various reports related to pending litigation utilizing RMIS technology.

Risk Management Resource

  • Acts as an independent resource person by presenting relevant risk management issues for discussion and evaluation.
  • Keeps abreast of appropriate regional regulatory requirements related to regional risk management.
  • Maintains clinical knowledge of best practices to ensure relevant and progressive risk management support.
  • Participates on committees directed toward promoting quality of care and is available to attend/cover other Committee meetings.
  • Educates operational teams on risk and safety issue reporting.
  • Engages with clinical providers and staff by demonstrating a Risk Management presence through virtual meeting attendance and/or on-site visits.

Risk Management Education

  • Assists in developing and presenting educational programs to raise staff awareness of risk exposure and the impact on professional liability.
  • In conjunction with human resources and operations, provides risk management orientation and support to new staff and providers within their Region.
  • Coordinates and delivers risk management program education to new acquisitions and supports the UUG Integration team as requested.

Note: This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities. Duties may change at any time, with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five (5) years of management experience required.
  • Minimum five (5) years of urology or oncology experience required.
  • Strong clinical background required.
  • Current CPHRM certification or attainment of CPHRM Certification within three years of hire.

Knowledge, Competencies & Skills

  • Knowledge of Veridigm EHR and Practice Management software required.
  • Working knowledge of Medical Terminology.
  • Ability to communicate tactfully and effectively with internal and external individuals electronically, by phone, in person, and in writing.
  • Proficient in database and spreadsheet management.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated for optimal remote productivity.
  • Ability to set priorities and meet timelines for performance expectations while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Must maintain strict standards regarding confidentiality.

Tech Requirements for the Job

  • High-speed, reliable internet connection to ensure uninterrupted communication and access to necessary systems and tools.
  • Quiet and private work environment to maintain the confidentiality of patient information and minimize background noise during calls.
  • Proficiency in using remote collaboration tools, such as video conferencing software, instant messaging platforms, and customer relationship management systems.
  • Compliance with all security and privacy policies and protocols, including safeguarding patient information and maintaining HIPAA compliance.

Travel

  • Must have the ability and willingness to travel to other sites as necessary within a geographic region.

Job Type: Full-Time

Pay Range: $80,000 - $90,000 annually

Actual compensation offered to candidates is based on work experience, education, skill level, and geographic location. Compensation may vary depending on the state or region in which the position is located, in accordance with applicable laws.

This position has no close date. Applications will be accepted until an offer has been extended and accepted.
